summary.text: Lily Cheng-Schulting is the Democratic candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 80, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A disability and education advocate according to a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she previously ran for the Michigan House in 2020 and 2022.

paragraphs.text: In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Lily Cheng-Schulting described herself as the mother of an autistic teenager and a college student and as a disability and education advocate.

She said she created a nonprofit and led a movement in response to cuts at center-based special education schools, which she said resulted in an independent audit and the transfer of management to Kent ISD.
Cheng-Schulting won the 2020 Democratic primary for Michigan House District 72, defeating Cade Wilson, and lost the general election to incumbent Republican Steven Johnson, 55.1% to 44.9%.
In 2022 she lost the Democratic primary for District 80 to Phil Skaggs, 52.9% to 47.1%.
She won the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary for District 80 with 40.4% of the vote, ahead of Kris Pachla and Kristen Fauson.
